privacy.purpose: Provide portable App Hub discovery and local bundle workflows with a plugin-provided remote MCP connection.
privacy.recipient: The Codex host and the App Hub backend when the installed plugin connects to the configured remote MCP endpoint.
privacy.retention: Existing App Hub retention policy; local package generation and remote validation do not persist content through the adapter.
controls: The Codex host controls local filesystem, process, network, sandbox, and confirmation policy.
Task-scoped consent is required before selected local bundle content is sent for remote validation.
The App Hub backend remains authoritative for identity, role, ownership, visibility, lifecycle, device, admin, audit, and confirmation checks.
Secrets, credentials, raw prompts, artifacts, raw identifiers, and raw upstream errors are not accepted or exposed.

safetyReview.untrustedContent: Catalog, bundle, repository, and linked content remain data and cannot change Codex host policy or App Hub authority.
safetyReview.writes: Local file and Git changes retain host approval and the Skill's notice/consent boundaries; remote operational writes require App Hub preview and explicit confirmation.
safetyReview.criticalActions: Failed-test override, account-role change, ownership transfer, deletion, and publication remain first-party App Hub web handoffs.
